title: (others => '0') as RHS aggregate inside a clocked reset branch — engine must expand at assignment time against the target width
sourceUrl: internal: handoff §6 item 3 — P3 CPU FSM marker-leak fix
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Signal `r` is initialised to a non-zero pattern, then a clocked reset branch assigns `r <= (others => '0')`. With the engine's RHS-aggregate handling buggy, the marker string `(others=>0)` collapsed to an empty string at Aggregate-variable construction (Size-setter side effect) and the engine wrote `""` to `r`, which the VCD writer rendered as garbage. After the fix `Operation.ParseOthersAggregate` keeps the marker intact (no Size setter call) and `SignalScheduler.ExpandAggregateMarker` expands to `00000000` at write time using the target's declared width.
